Corollary
[Continuous boundary data on a ball] 1. ch6:6.23\group gt-ch06 Under Theorem 6.22, every $\varphi \in C^0(\bar B)$ gives a unique solution $u\in C^0(\bar B)\cap C^{2,\alpha }(B)$ of $Lu=f$ in $B$, $u=\varphi $ on $\partial B$.
Proof

\sketch Approximate $\varphi $ uniformly by smooth data, solve after subtracting the approximants, and use the maximum principle and Corollary 6.3 to pass to the limit.

□
